# Scenario 3: Validation failure and safe fallback (Atomic Rollback)
# Ensures that broken Git commits soft-fail validation without destroying running apps.

# Step 1: Initialize Git with a VALID configuration
cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: valid setup'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# Step 2: Deploy initial working version
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Step 3: Break configuration and commit (Provide both domain-name and port)
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.broken.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: break configuration intentionally'
cd ..

# Step 4: Run agent against broken config (Expect soft-error / non-zero code)
exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'done duration='

# Step 5: Critical Safety Check
# The application from the first deployment cycle must still be up and running!
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1


# --- FILE TEMPLATES ---

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.broken.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: ://example.com
        port: 9999 # INVALID: Mutually exclusive with domain-name
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    expose:
      - "80"
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
